title: Folder links: Files scene reads ?folder from router; navFilesTabLogic.openFolder reveals in side panel
answers: Folder link ignores folder query parameter
How to reveal a folder in the Files tab programmatically
body:
ProjectFilesScene.tsx reads `searchParams.folder` via useValues(router) (not paramsToProps) so navigation between `/files?folder=...` URLs updates without remount; the explicit `folder` prop overrides for stories.
To reveal a folder in the nav Files tab, call navFilesTabLogic.actions.openFolder(folder) (navFilesTabLogic.ts). It resets search/sort/onlyFolders, expands folders, and keeps `folderToReveal` until the folder loads (subscription on viableItems), then scrolls once and clears it. NavTabFiles.tsx keys the section on `folderRevealCount` to remount.
Terminal behavior needs `posthog-terminal`; Files-tab reveal also needs `simple-sidepanel`, otherwise open the Files page.
